node.statement: Conditionally on the scalar facts just displayed (equivalently, for any witnesses and W satisfying those displayed facts), let A be a finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra with 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN and set t=epsilon. Since t <= W.r_reset <= e_0 and epsilon <= t, lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion furnishes the literal scalar map u_0:C->A, u_0(lambda)=lambda I_A. The initial-call clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, applied at this same t and target ambient defect epsilon <= t, states that this same literal u_0 is an extended D_*t-inclusion and ||u_0(I_C)-I_A|| <= D_*t. Recording its global-scalar tag, source C, target A, scale t, target defect epsilon, literal level-one map, and fixed amplifications makes it the explicit raw call required by def-maincb-raw-call; no replacement map is introduced.
